Animal geography is a subfield of the nature–society/human–environment branch of [geography](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geography) as well as a part of the larger, interdisciplinary umbrella of [human–animal studies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human–animal_studies) (HAS).

Animal migration tracking is used in [wildlife biology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wildlife_biology), [conservation biology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conservation_biology), [ecology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ecology), and [wildlife management](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wildlife_management) to study animals' behavior in the wild.
Animal mummification was common in [ancient Egypt](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ancient_Egypt).

Zoological Science is a [peer-reviewed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peer-reviewed) [scientific journal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scientific_journal) published by the [Zoological Society](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoological_society) of [Japan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Japan) covering the broad field of [zoology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoology).
zoological society is a group or organization, often a [voluntary association](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voluntary_association), interested in fields of study related to the animal kingdom.

Zoological Society of London (ZSL) is a charity and organization devoted to the worldwide [conservation of animals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Animal_conservation) and their [habitats](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Habitat_conservation).
zoological specimen is an animal or part of an animal preserved for scientific use.

Zoological Studies is a [peer-reviewed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peer-reviewed) [open access](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open_access) [scientific journal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scientific_journal) covering [zoology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoology), with focuses on [animal behavior](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Animal_behavior), [comparative physiology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Comparative_physiology), [evolution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evolution), [ecology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ecology), [systematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Systematics) and [biogeography](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biogeography).

Zoologische Verhandelingen was a [Dutch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Netherlands) [scientific journal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scientific_journal) covering research in [zoology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoology).

Zoologischer Anzeiger – A Journal of Comparative Zoology is a [peer-reviewed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peer_review) [scientific journal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scientific_journal) specialising in the field of [comparative](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Comparative_biology) [zoology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoology).

Zoology is a bimonthly [peer-reviewed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peer-reviewed) [scientific journal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scientific_journal) covering [zoology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoology) that was established in 1886.

Zoomorphology is a quarterly [academic journal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academic_journal) published by [Springer-Verlag Germany](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Springer-Verlag_Germany) of [Berlin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Berlin), Germany.
Zoomorphs is a line of educational building toys made by River Dolphin Toys, a Brooklyn-based company.
zoophyte (animal-plant) is an obsolete term for an organism thought to be intermediate between animals and plants, or an animal with plant-like attributes or appearance.

definition: Zooplankton are the [heterotroph](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heterotroph)ic component of the [plankton](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plankton)ic community, having to consume other organisms to thrive.
Zoosadism is a type of [sadism](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Everyday_sadism) in which it involves pleasure derived from [cruelty to animals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cruelty_to_animals).

Zoosphaerium album, also known as the giant opal pill millipede, is a species of [pill millipede](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pill_millipede) within the family [Arthrosphaeridae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arthrosphaeridae) and order [Sphaerotheriida](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sphaerotheriida).

Zoosystema is a [peer-reviewed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peer_review) [scientific journal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scientific_journal) published by the [National Museum of Natural History, France](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/National_Museum_of_Natural_History,_France) (Muséum national d'histoire naturelle), covering research in animal [biodiversity](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biodiversity).

Zoosystematica Rossica is a [peer-reviewed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peer-reviewed) [open access](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open_access) [scientific journal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scientific_journal) covering any aspects of [systematic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Systematics) [zoology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zoology).

Zoosystematics and Evolution is a [peer-reviewed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peer-reviewed) [open access](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Open_access) [scientific journal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scientific_journal) covering zoological [systematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Systematics) and [evolution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evolution).

Zootaxa is a [peer-reviewed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peer_review) [scientific](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scientific_journal) [mega journal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mega_journal) for [animal taxonomists](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taxonomy_(biology)).
Zuljanah () was a grey Arabian Stallion that belonged to [Husayn ibn Ali](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Husayn_ibn_Ali).

definition: Zuma tioga is a species of armoured [harvestman](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harvestman) in the family [Paranonychidae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paranonychidae).

Zuyaqui (died 2000s) was a dog who, according to [SEDENA](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SEDENA), was the dog who found the most [drugs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Illegal_drugs) in Mexican military and police history.
Zyzzyzus floridanus is a species of marine [hydrozoan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydrozoan) in the family [Tubulariidae](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tubulariidae).
Águia Vitória is the [mascot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mascot) of Portuguese [football](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Association_football) club [[S.L.

Älgen Stolta was a [moose](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moose) that became known for participating in a [trot racing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harness_racing) event in [Falun](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falun), Sweden, in 1907.

Édouard Pail (17 October 1851, [Corbigny](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corbigny) - 6 December 1916, [Villeneuve-le-Roi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Villeneuve-le-Roi)) was a French landscape and animal painter; primarily of sheep.

Émile van Marcke, born Charles Émile van Marcke de Lummen (15 August 1827 in [Sèvres](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sèvres) – 24 December 1890 in [Hyeres](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyeres)), was a [French](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_people) cattle painter.

definition: Şerafettin (often shortened to Şero; 2005 – 28 September 2024) was a [cat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cat) living in [Ankara](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ankara), [Turkey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Turkey), who resided in the headquarters of the [Republican People's Party](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Republican_People's_Party) (CHP) from the building's construction in 2004 until his death in 2024.
Železník (29 April 1978 – 22 December 2004) was a Czechoslovak racehorse, the four-time winner of the [Velká pardubická](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Velká_pardubická) steeplechase.
